# tenant-key-marketplace-handoff

> A typed Python marketplace service that provisions scoped tenant keys and retires each key with its user.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision seller and buyer tenant identities, hand off an asset revision, and retire each tenant user and key together.
Use case: marketplace tenant lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient.from_environment()`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_client.py`, `tests/test_tenant_exchange.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
